_purpose: What this release is pinned to and what it must contain. A release that cannot name the exact commits it was built from cannot be rebuilt, and a game whose plant records are decoded by a shared codec must be able to say which codec.
name: pleb-plant-grower

pins._note: Host and archive share an aggregate layout (docs/EMBEDDING.md section 2), so a consumer must build against these same commits. Mixing SDK commits across one build is unsafe and fails silently rather than at link time.

generated_at_build._note: Deterministic build products, gitignored and gated against their generators rather than against stored hashes.

provenance_allowlist._note: Every shipped byte is either written here, generated by a tracked stdlib-only tool, or a model generation recorded in assets/graphics/prompts.json and accepted by the owner.

publication._note: No remote is configured and none may be added until the owner calls the game complete. The art review gate (tools/check_art_review.py) must also have a non-empty manifest with an accept verdict before any generation ships.
